version: as published with LiTraj (repository pushed_at 2025-06-05; paper npj Comput. Mater. 11, 131, 2025)
role: high_fidelity_transport_supervision (DATA_CONTRACT.md dataset role C: existing published DFT-NEB migration barriers)
paper_reference: Dembitskiy et al., "Benchmarking machine learning models for predicting lithium ion migration", npj Computational Materials 11, 131 (2025)
record_unit: one Li-ion vacancy hop with a climbing-image DFT(PBE)-NEB-optimized migration barrier
available_structure_fields: per-edge initial (BVSE-NEB preconditioned) and DFT-NEB-relaxed trajectory .xyz files (<edge_id>_init.xyz, <edge_id>_relaxed.xyz)
nebDFT2k_centroids.xyz: supercell with inserted centroid ('X') per edge, for GNN structure-to-property use

target_fields.em_dft: DFT(PBE)-NEB migration barrier, eV -- this is the existing-published-DFT-NEB target per DATA_CONTRACT.md role C
target_fields.em_bvse: BVSE-NEB estimate for the same hop, included for cross-fidelity comparison only, not a substitute target
target_fields.has_specific_TM: boolean flag for hops involving a specific transition metal, present in the index for filtering/analysis

known_missing_censored_disordered_data: No missing em_dft values (0/1681). No censored values (DFT barrier, always numeric). 0 duplicate edge_id rows (verified). Disorder of underlying structures not separately re-verified in this phase.
notes: This dataset's material_id set (867) is an exact subset of both bvse_hops' (11,290) and bvel_percolation's (12,807) material_id sets (see reports/results/leakage/pretraining_id_overlap.json). No new DFT/NEB calculations were performed or are planned to obtain this data -- it is downloaded published output only, consistent with RESEARCH_CONTRACT.md and DATA_CONTRACT.md role C ('Existing published DFT-NEB migration barriers only. No new DFT/NEB generation.'). em_bvse vs em_dft on the same 1,681 hops is available in this dataset for a cross-fidelity sanity check but must not be conflated as three fidelities of one target per RESEARCH_CONTRACT.md's forbidden-claims list.
